PLAN "12-Week Low-Impact Strength Return-to-Ski"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Restore strength and knee resilience for skiing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Base Rebuild and Knee Tolerance" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body Strength A (controlled ROM)":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Body Strength A":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Lower Body Strength B (hinge focus)":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          split_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
